scientific_conclusion.specification: Post-Earnings Announcement Drift (PEAD) raw momentum entry with 30-session holding period on NIFTY 50 large-cap equities
scientific_conclusion.verdict_scope: SPECIFICATION_LEVEL_REJECTION (v1 tested specification rejected; PEAD alpha family preserved for future refined variants)

timeline.milestone: Forensic Audit of Corrected DEVELOPMENT Results

lessons_learned.engineering: Interface contracts must explicitly propagate active portfolio position state into strategy signal generation methods to prevent counter starvation.
lessons_learned.governance: Governance locks and forensic consistency audits prevent false positive strategy deployment by detecting interface defects before capital risk.
lessons_learned.implementation: Time-based holding period exits must maintain an active session counter linked directly to live portfolio positions.
lessons_learned.statistical: Passive holding in bull markets can create false positive alpha if exit rules fail to execute; rigorous exit auditing is mandatory.
lessons_learned.quantitative_strategy: Raw single-factor PEAD momentum entry without market regime filters, volume gates, or earnings surprise filters fails to generate positive edge on Indian large-cap equities over 30-session holding periods.
